var_ContactId.title: var_ContactId
var_ContactId.description: The diner's unique numeric Contact ID (e.g., 10008155).

var_NewDateTime.title: var_NewDateTime
var_NewDateTime.description: The new reservation date and time formatted in ISO-8601 using the restaurant's local timezone offset (-05:00 for Austin/Chicago CDT, -04:00 for New York/Miami EDT, -07:00 for Los Angeles PDT). Example for 4:00 PM in Austin: 2026-10-27T16:00:00-05:00. NEVER pass raw UTC or append 'Z'.

var_NewPartySize.title: var_NewPartySize
var_NewPartySize.description: The requested total number of dining guests.

var_NewSpecialRequests.title: var_NewSpecialRequests
var_NewSpecialRequests.description: Updated dietary restrictions, food allergies, seating preferences, or special celebrations (anniversary, birthday, business meal).

var_ReservationIdentifier.title: var_ReservationIdentifier
var_ReservationIdentifier.description: The reservation confirmation code (e.g., 'RES-001'). If not provided, targets the nearest upcoming active booking.

var_RestaurantId.title: var_RestaurantId
var_RestaurantId.description: The unique restaurant identifier code (e.g., REST-ATX-01).
